Database Schema:
CREATE TABLE `state` (
  `state_name` TEXT,
  `population` NUMBER,
  `area` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `capital` TEXT,
  `density` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`state_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `city` (
  `city_name` TEXT,
  `population` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`city_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `border_info` (
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  `border` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`border`)
);

CREATE TABLE `highlow` (
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  `highest_elevation` TEXT,
  `lowest_point` TEXT,
  `highest_point` TEXT,
  `lowest_elevation` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`state_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `lake` (
  `lake_name` TEXT,
  `area` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE `mountain` (
  `mountain_name` TEXT,
  `mountain_altitude` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`mountain_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `river` (
  `river_name` TEXT,
  `length` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `traverse` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`river_name`)
);

Question:
what is the biggest city in wyoming
answer: SELECT city_name FROM city WHERE population  =  ( SELECT MAX ( population ) FROM city WHERE state_name  =  "wyoming" ) AND state_name  =  "wyoming";

CREATE TABLE `state` (
  `state_name` TEXT,
  `population` NUMBER,
  `area` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `capital` TEXT,
  `density` NUMBER,
  PRIMARY KEY (`state_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `city` (
  `city_name` TEXT,
  `population` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`city_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `border_info` (
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  `border` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`border`)
);

CREATE TABLE `highlow` (
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  `highest_elevation` TEXT,
  `lowest_point` TEXT,
  `highest_point` TEXT,
  `lowest_elevation` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`state_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `lake` (
  `lake_name` TEXT,
  `area` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE `mountain` (
  `mountain_name` TEXT,
  `mountain_altitude` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `state_name` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`mountain_name`)
);

CREATE TABLE `river` (
  `river_name` TEXT,
  `length` NUMBER,
  `country_name` TEXT,
  `traverse` TEXT REFERENCES `state`(`state_name`),
  PRIMARY KEY (`river_name`)
);

Question:
name all the rivers in illinois
answer: SELECT river_name FROM river WHERE traverse  =  "illinois";

answer: SELECT t2.title FROM movie AS t2 JOIN made_by AS t3 ON t2.mid  =  t3.msid JOIN producer AS t1 ON t1.pid  =  t3.pid JOIN written_by AS t5 ON t5.msid  =  t2.mid JOIN writer AS t4 ON t5.wid  =  t4.wid WHERE t1.name  =  "Woody Allen" AND t4.name  =  "Woody Allen";
